risks.risk: Exact PS4 model (Fat/Slim/Pro) is not readable; price differs by model.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label/serial sticker showing the exact model (CUH-xxxx) and a side-by-side shot of the console model type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest matching PS4 type in the comparables (worst case: not Pro).

risks.risk: Controller count/condition may be less than claimed (2 pads) or one pad may be faulty.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo showing both controllers together, plus a short clip of both controllers pairing and working in the PS4 menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 1 working controller (worst case vs '2 pads').

risks.risk: Games may not be included as licensed discs (or may be fewer than 10).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of all game cases/discs laid out (showing titles) or a video scrolling the installed games list on the PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (worst case: games not included/uncertain).

risks.risk: Ports may have faults (HDMI/USB), or console may have performance issues not visible in a photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing HDMI output to TV and testing USB ports (plugging a USB device) and controller charging/recognition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working ports (worst case: treat as basic/untested).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues may exist despite 'no overheating' claim.
risks.proof: Ask for a clip of the console running a game for 15–20 minutes with the seller showing no shutdowns and (if possible) a temperature/health indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential thermal issue risk (worst case: not guaranteed).

proof_requests: Photo of the PS4 model label/serial sticker (CUH-xxxx) and a clear shot of the console type (Fat/Slim/Pro).
Photo showing both controllers together; then a short clip pairing and navigating the PS4 home screen with both pads.
Photo/video showing the full set of included games (titles visible) or the installed games list on the PS4.
Short video testing HDMI output and at least two USB ports working (plug/unplug a USB device).
Clip showing the console running for 15–20 minutes without shutdown/overheating.
response.reason: The photo confirms a PS4 console and one controller, but the key details that determine the correct price (exact PS4 model, confirmed 2 pads, confirmed included licensed games/FC24, and port/overheating status) are not verifiable from the single image.
